# Tally My Project

> Free, no-signup calculators for home improvement projects in the US, real estate decisions in India, and AI-generated house floor plans. Every calculator shows its formula and a worked example alongside the result — not just a number.

## Home Improvement Calculators (US, USD)

- [Concrete Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/concrete): Cubic yards, bag count, and cost for slabs, footings, and columns.
- [Tile Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/tile): Tiles, boxes, and cost needed for floors, walls, and bathrooms, including waste allowance.
- [Roofing Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/roofing): Roofing squares, shingle bundles, and material cost from roof size and pitch.
- [Mulch & Gravel Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/mulch-gravel): Cubic yards and bags of mulch, gravel, or topsoil needed for a yard.
- [Flooring Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/flooring): Materials and cost for hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring.

## India Real Estate Calculators (INR)

- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/home-loan-emi): Monthly EMI, total interest, and total repayment for any loan amount, rate, and tenure.
- [Stamp Duty & Registration Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/stamp-duty): Stamp duty and registration charges by Indian state.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/rent-vs-buy): Projected net worth from buying a home vs. renting and investing the difference.
- [Property Tax Calculator](https://tallymyproject.com/calculators/property-tax): Annual property tax from assessed value, tax rate, and early-payment rebate.

## House Plans

- [AI Floor Plan Generator](https://tallymyproject.com/floor-plan): Generates an editable, dimension-aware 2D floor plan for Indian residential plots from a plain-English description.

## Notes

- All calculators and guides are free, require no sign-up, and are ad-supported.
- Figures in guides are national/typical averages for context; calculators compute a result from the user's own inputs.
- Full page index: https://tallymyproject.com/sitemap.xml
